Found the relevant behavior, but not the specific "committer account deleted" wrinkle — that's not documented as its own trigger.

**File:** `content/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/events-that-trigger-workflows.md`, `schedule` event section (line 964):

> In a public repository, scheduled workflows are automatically disabled when no repository activity has occurred in 60 days.

The docs describe the general 60-days-of-inactivity auto-disable, and separately state re-enabling is covered in `disable-and-enable-workflows.md#enabling-a-workflow`. There's no documented rule tying this specifically to a deleted committer's account, nor any mention of a warning/notification being sent to other repo maintainers — so this appears to be an undocumented edge case, not something these docs address directly.
